name: Should I use chemical drain cleaners for a clogged bathtub drain?

mainEntity.name: Should I use chemical drain cleaners for a clogged bathtub drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally not recommended to use chemical drain cleaners for a clogged bathtub drain. While they may offer a temporary fix, these harsh chemicals can corrode pipes over time, particularly older plumbing systems, leading to more significant damage and costly repairs. They can also pose health risks due to fumes and skin contact. A practical tradeoff is to consider professional snaking or hydro-jetting, which effectively clear blockages without pipe damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Chemical drain cleaners are not recommended as they can damage pipes and pose health risks. Professional cleaning is a safer, more effective option.
